meta.approvalScope: Implementation of the coordinator-approved architecture only; no Azure deployment authorization.

inputs.userGoal: Ziel ist es eine lauffähige Pilot Demo zu entwickeln der darstellt wie mit AI Agenten der PMS prozess automatisiert werden kann.
subGoals: Prepare the bounded Bicep/CI portion only, without deployment or changes to application sources.
Private, passwordless data paths; synthetic cases and simulator-only transmissions.
EU-bounded processing, independently monitored operations, explicit capacity/cost/retention/recovery gates.
insightsApplied: cohors-approved-pilot: implementation approval is not deployment or clinical/operational approval.
cohors-no-azure-inventory: all subscription, availability, quota, cost and existing-platform references remain unverified inputs.
cohors-eu-boundary: candidate EU locations and geography-based Standard model deployment only; no Global or automatic fallback.
cohors-state-authority: SQL authority, reconstructable Search, isolated Durable Blob/Queue/Table dependencies and separate Operations.

cohors-runtime-observed: shared Web/API plus separate AgentHost container, two Flex code packages/OneDeploy, exact workload roles/SQL/telemetry contracts and real loopback SQL tests; cloud integration remains gated.
cohors-retention-gates: no WORM lock or automatic SQL digest upload; separated publisher/verifier identities and explicit acceptance gates.

cohors-requirements-source: coordinator-read matrix has 118 unique IDs; L-01/L-03/L-05 and architecture v0.3 clarify retention, recovery, audit and privacy controls without granting deployment or production exceptions.

properties.externalDependency: Required reviewed egress route table in the same subscription/region, reachable approved hub firewall/NVA, peering and operator/runner private access. Not discovered or provisioned here.
properties.networkSecurityGroups: Separate subnet NSGs; endpoint access limited to private TLS and SQL proxy traffic.

reasoning.whyChosen: Security: isolate ingress, workloads and private endpoints. Dedicated Flex subnets must not share the Container Apps environment subnet.
reasoning.tradeoffs: The approved platform egress/access connection is a mandatory external gate, not an invented existing resource. CIDRs are examples, not an approved IP allocation.

properties.privateEndpoints: Microsoft.Network/privateEndpoints@2024-07-01 with privateDnsZoneGroups@2024-07-01; one endpoint per storage subresource, per PaaS target and for AMPLS.
properties.existingDnsGate: Do not create duplicate zones in a connected landing zone; adapt to existing authoritative zones before deployment.

reasoning.whyChosen: Security/reliability: service FQDNs must resolve privately; AMPLS uses one scope per shared DNS context.
reasoning.tradeoffs: DNS links alone do not provide VPN/peering or conditional forwarding for remote clients.

properties.entraGate: Tenant app registrations, app roles, product grants, user separation and CI federation are separate bootstrap actions, not ARM role assignments.

reasoning.whyChosen: Security: separate deployable identities and no workload credentials. Agent identity has no SQL, evidence-write, approval or transmission privilege.
alternativesConsidered: One privileged identity for every host
reasoning.tradeoffs: Application roles and Azure resource RBAC are distinct; neither substitutes for SQL contained users.

reasoning.whyChosen: Operational excellence: isolated telemetry with explicit short pilot retention.
alternativesConsidered: Using business evidence as operational logs
reasoning.tradeoffs: No daily ingestion hard cap that silently drops watchdog telemetry; cost alerts and reviewed retention are required.

properties.diagnostics: Allowlisted metadata/system logs and metrics only; no model prompts, clinical bodies, SQL batches or search query text.

reasoning.whyChosen: Operational excellence/security: correlate failures without copying medical content into telemetry.
reasoning.tradeoffs: SDK/host redaction and unsampled successful-heartbeat emission require application verification.

reasoning.whyChosen: Security: private application telemetry ingestion and private operator queries.
reasoning.tradeoffs: Diagnostic-setting traffic uses a Microsoft service channel; AMPLS is not a universal outbound filter. Global here is control-plane location, not a model deployment type.

properties.actionGroup: Required existing approved action-group resource ID; no recipient or subscription invented.
properties.semantics: Count exact Operations success events in the inclusive interval [ago(3m), now()]. A last success older than three minutes, or no success, produces MissingSuccess=1 even for empty input; no grouping or union.
properties.windowSize: PT15M; query scan range, not the three-minute missing-success threshold.
properties.activation: Rule omitted by default. Enabling requires watchdogQueryReadiness evidence: initial AppEvents ingestion/schema, private AAD query access and one-minute query validation. Never fake an Operations success for bootstrap. Rule health and measured ingestion/evaluation/delivery remain acceptance gates.

reasoning.whyChosen: Reliability: missing success must alarm independently of the agent runtime.
reasoning.tradeoffs: No guaranteed three-minute cloud notification latency. Keep the pilot acceptance gate open if measured ingestion/evaluation/delivery misses the profile; do not extend the threshold. The separate five-minute in-app escalation deadline is not a heartbeat tolerance.

properties.lifecycleDeletion: Not configured; class-specific retention needs approval.

reasoning.whyChosen: Security/reliability: versioned evidence, separate quarantine and approved-package boundaries, recoverable accidental deletion.
alternativesConsidered: A single immutable bucket for all data classes
reasoning.tradeoffs: Soft delete/versioning are recovery features, not WORM or an independently protected archive.

identityRoles: Storage Blob Data Owner for host

reasoning.whyChosen: Reliability: dedicated Workflow host/task-hub state with every required private endpoint, DNS name and data role.
alternativesConsidered: Additional Service Bus or Durable Task Scheduler
reasoning.tradeoffs: Host data roles permit technical state mutation. They must never apply to business evidence or immutable digest storage.

reasoning.whyChosen: Reliability/security: Operations host storage is independent of agent and Workflow hosts.
reasoning.tradeoffs: Separate apps still share subscription-level regional Flex quotas. Operations outbox/inbox remains in SQL, not a new queue broker.

properties.authentication: UserAssignedIdentity; separate deployment container per app

reasoning.whyChosen: Security/operations: isolate deployable code from host/task-hub and evidence data.
reasoning.tradeoffs: Flex uses OneDeploy, not WEBSITE_RUN_FROM_PACKAGE or Azure Files. Package deployment requires a private-network runner and separate approval.

properties.immutabilityPolicy: None; production and demo locking both require a separate approved retention decision.
properties.publisher: Dedicated identity, not the API or database administrator; attachment to a verified worker remains gated.

reasoning.whyChosen: Security: reserve an independently authorized digest destination without pretending unprotected hashes prove privileged-tamper resistance.
alternativesConsidered: Automatic upload through an opened storage firewall
reasoning.tradeoffs: LRS is a conservative candidate for the automatic-digest compatibility spike, not a proven private upload solution. Worker, protected append writes, locked policy and verification must be demonstrated separately.

properties.administrator: Required Entra administrative group object ID and display name
properties.audit: Selected authentication, principal/permission and ledger-operation groups; no BATCH_COMPLETED_GROUP. Events can still contain SQL statements/identifiers: L-05 classification and approved ingestion/retention are mandatory. Route server audit through master diagnostic settings.
properties.threatProtection: Optional server securityAlertPolicies@2023-08-01, omitted by default; never emit a Disabled policy or subscription-wide pricing/onboarding. Existing/inherited Defender and policy state remains unverified. Activation requires distinct cost, statement/privacy, EU, access/retention and SecOps reviews; targeted recipients only, no all-admin email.

reasoning.whyChosen: Security: passwordless private relational authority and explicit privileged-operation audit.
alternativesConsidered: Public firewall with Allow Azure Services
reasoning.tradeoffs: Entra group and SQL contained-user/procedure grants are separate authorized bootstrap steps. No broad db_owner grant to runtime.

references.title: SQL audit schema and master routing

properties.backupRedundancy: Local or Zone only; no unreviewed geo copy
properties.ledger: Append-only audit table selected by application migration, not ledger-on for every business table.

reasoning.whyChosen: Reliability/consistency: transactions, constraints, concurrency, outbox/inbox and auditable versions.
reasoning.tradeoffs: General Purpose/zone availability, capacity, RPO/RTO and PITR consistency with Blob remain unverified. A table ledger does not protect all tables.

properties.indexing: Push from authorized API/rebuild path; no indexers, skillsets, outbound private-link dependencies or primary-state claims.

reasoning.whyChosen: Performance: reconstructable permission-filtered projection of authoritative evidence.
alternativesConsidered: Reading the search index as archive
reasoning.tradeoffs: A one-replica pilot is not production availability; no self-service backup. Index definition and ACL/version/freshness tests are application gates.

properties.modelDeployment: Optional Microsoft.CognitiveServices/accounts/deployments@2025-06-01; explicit model name/version/capacity, Standard only, NoAutoUpgrade, no spillover.
properties.diagnostics: Metrics only; no request/response or prompt capture.

reasoning.whyChosen: Security: self-hosted bounded agents use a private identity-authenticated model endpoint.
alternativesConsidered: Hosted Agent Service with extra state/dependencies
reasoning.tradeoffs: Current deployment-type docs include EFTA in the EU Data Boundary while the privacy page still uses EU-member-nations wording. DataZone/Global/Developer are not authorized. Standard is geography-based, not necessarily single-region. AgentHost requires EU-Member-States plus a canonical configuration-hash-bound provider review; no combination is assumed available.

references.title: Model version and no automatic upgrade
Privacy page with different EU wording

properties.secrets: No seeded secrets and no default runtime access; add only an approved secret-level contract.

reasoning.whyChosen: Security: protected future cryptographic/external-secret boundary, not an evidence store.
reasoning.tradeoffs: Purge protection creates a retention/cost commitment distinct from unapproved evidence WORM. No CMK configuration without lifecycle/availability review.

properties.imageContract: Approved ACR repository@sha256 digest; private build/push runner required.

reasoning.whyChosen: Security/operations: Premium is required for private endpoints; managed-identity pull and immutable release references.
reasoning.tradeoffs: Private-link and registry charges must be approved. No image is published by this preparation task.

properties.ingressDns: Private zone for the generated environment default domain, wildcard and apex A records to the internal static IP.

reasoning.whyChosen: Security/cost: shared private managed environment for Web/API and agent runtime, without AKS.
alternativesConsidered: Consumption-only environment with weaker network capabilities
reasoning.tradeoffs: Private participant access is required; no public demo bypass. Minimum replicas/zone support need workload-specific review.

properties.health: API and separate AgentHost each listen on 8080, /health/live and /health/ready; immutable cohors-api/cohors-agents images from their Dockerfiles with repository build context.
properties.auth: Entra only; API MI receives Agent application role at AgentHost, explicit Agents__Products__N; no LocalDemo, runtime migration, local storage or local watchdog in Azure.

reasoning.whyChosen: Security/operations: stateless versioned hosts with separate identities and probe contracts.
alternativesConsidered: Unverified placeholder images deployed as working services
reasoning.tradeoffs: Runtime activation requires real digest-pinned images, authenticated agent host and application acceptance; no fake integration.

properties.plans: Two separate Microsoft.Web/serverfarms@2024-11-01, one app per Flex plan.
properties.runtime: dotnet-isolated 10.0 on Functions 4.x; verify supported runtime value and package generation before deployment.
properties.deployment: Release dotnet-publish package via Flex OneDeploy; functionAppConfig.deployment.storage: blobContainer + UserAssignedIdentity; no Azure Files, legacy FUNCTIONS_WORKER_RUNTIME/FUNCTIONS_EXTENSION_VERSION appsettings or WEBSITE_RUN_FROM_PACKAGE. Dockerfiles are local tests only.
properties.limits: 2048 MB candidate, 40-instance per-scaling-group ceiling. Workflows always-ready durable/http, independent Operations function:DeadlineWatchdog; not a quota guarantee or total-spend cap.
properties.operations: Independent SQL deadline/lease/outbox tick every 30 seconds; emits unsampled cohors.watchdog.completed only after successful SQL completion, AppRoleName cohors-operations. No dependency on API, Foundry or Search for the tick.

reasoning.whyChosen: Reliability: independent Operations timer/watchdog and replay-safe Durable Workflow hosts.
reasoning.tradeoffs: No Flex slots. Packages, trigger discovery, App Insights AAD ingestion, private scale access and least-privilege API app roles must be tested.

overallReasoning.summary: Prepare the approved small PaaS architecture with private identity-based data access, SQL authority, reconstructable projections and independently monitored operations. Do not deploy resources or fabricate integration evidence.
overallReasoning.tradeoffs: WAF/insights/schema-specific MCP tools are unavailable; current Microsoft Learn pages, official schemas and one consolidated WAF/naming research pass replace them. Naming documentation omits exact managed-environment/model-deployment constraints; conservative generated names plus a live preflight remain necessary. Region/SKU/model/quotas/pricing, landing-zone egress/private access, Entra, image/package publication, runtime integration, strict EU processing boundaries, external protected ledger digests and recovery are open deployment/operations gates. Pilot defaults do not promise HA, RPO/RTO, regulatory compliance or production retention. No AKS, Cosmos DB, additional broker, azd, clinical connection or automatic global failover is introduced.

plan.validation: 2026-11-15: Bicep 0.49.2 build/lint/example parameters, PowerShell syntax, Actionlint 1.7.12 and 25 offline gate/report/watchdog-contract tests passed. The query tests use bounded SQLite translation, not a Kusto engine or Azure scheduler. Network-isolated Checkov 3.4.5 scanned all 36 compiled template exports: 184 passed, 79 finding occurrences across 17 controls, 0 skipped, 0 parsing errors; resource_count=246 includes nested/module occurrences. Security gate remains BLOCKED (validator exit 1); per-control classification is in docs/azure-infrastructure.md, with no suppressions or accepted production exceptions. No Azure login, deployment, what-if, live provider validation, application integration or recovery test was performed here.
architecturePrinciples: SQL is the authoritative state, with transactional audit/outbox/inbox.
Human medical and regulatory decisions remain distinct; no workload identity may approve.
Public data-plane access and shared-key authentication are disabled.
EU-bounded processing requires feature/deployment-type review, not a region label alone.
No locked retention or protected-digest assurance without its explicit acceptance gate.
No empty test suite, skipped SQL tests, silent fallback or success-shaped placeholder.
Foundation provisioning and functional cloud readiness are separate.
